finding: For a fixed admissible odd box with bands [1,3/2],[2,4],[5,7] and five rational nodes (201/200,299/200,31/20,399/200,11/5), the selector F=(-t)(xi-t)(4-t) with xi=t3 fails on one explicit full-width stable box and one actual four-node odd-canceling ray, while xi=t4 fails on a different explicit full-width stable box and ray. Both have strict exact negative selected pairings and zero odd moments. By exact enumeration of 3432 active subsets, the fixed-odd closed stable-even-box cone has 32 primitive extreme rays; all four middle-odd-endpoint/ray functionals are strictly positive on all rays exactly for theta=(xi-t3)/(t4-t3) in (8801570077871/24204052524794,20976207035859270/21352321470099371). In particular theta=1/2 works uniformly for every admissible even box and actual atoms at these fixed data; 128 ray pairings are positive, minimum 33004561845260000/9531570158068959 on the listed primitive rays. This proves interior-selector freedom is genuinely needed for a uniform proof, not an unrestricted no-go or universal SPR verdict.
